        fact[i]=fact[i-1]*i%MOD
    inv_fact=[1]*(K+1)

        if new_max>K:
            new_max=K
        ndp=[0]*(K+1)
        # local
        _dp=dp
        _inv=inv_fact

        for n in range(new_max+1):
